events.title: Calgary Songsmith
events.description: Canada's largest independent songwriter group...going strong since 2003! (Sponsored by Simply Socials, the Calgary Folk Club, Studio D, Tree Picks and the National Music Centre) We support both new and established songwriters in southern Alberta with workshops, resources, mentoring, opportunities to perform, and educational sessions on different aspects of the songwriting business. There are no membership fees and the sessions are open to all ages. — Free
